name: project
description: Per-project atlas + map + Kanban board with hierarchical tasks, workstream-tagged cards, and All-Projects hub. v1.4.0 MINOR (v0.31.0 S6.5): hub note filename now defaults to the user-typed project name (e.g. 'Testing It All Out.md' under spice/projects/testing-it-all-out/) for native Obsidian tab title display. Configurable HUB_NOTE_FILENAME_STYLE constant in project-nav-buttons.js (name|slug|fixed). Rule_fragment refactored to type-discrimination via frontmatter_branch so audit + hub-cards filters are filename-independent. v1.4.1 PATCH CF-1: projects-hub-cards.js filter restored to match EITHER type:project OR legacy #project tag (older hub notes without type:project frontmatter were excluded from the Projects.md card grid); defensive type:map/kanban exclusions handle dataview's nested-tag expansion (#project/<slug> would otherwise falsely include Project Map + Project Board). v1.5.0 MINOR (v0.33.0 cohesion wave 2): adopts claude_surface[] — ships canonical /project slash command + new-project SKILL.md + resolvers row. Stale consumer-side .claude/commands/project.md bodies overwritten on next install. v1.6.0 MINOR (v0.39.0): NEW frontmatter fields status (7-state enum, required) + status_changed_at (YYYY-MM-DD, required) + teams[] + products[] (both optional wikilink lists). Default-active hub scope hides terminal statuses (superseded/cancelled/done). Tier 1 action buttons (Bump Status / Set Teams / Set Products) ship via ProjectActionButtons customjs class (S7). v1.7.0 MINOR (v0.46.0 S6): New Project create flow extracted to entity-create@0.1.0 mechanism — ProjectNavButtons._promptForProjectName / _createProject / _renderProjectsHub deleted (~184 LOC stripped), the class retains task-note + workstream + nav-row rendering only. Manifest declares new_entity_buttons[] with id=project, exercising three schema extensions for the first time: prompts[].derive (slugify(prompts.name)), extra_files[] for the Project Map + <slug>-board sidecars, and frontmatter_template with literal defaults (status:idea, status_changed_at:{{now.YYYY-MM-DD}}, workstreams:[]). content/Projects.md swaps the inline ProjectNavButtons-dispatched dataviewjs block for an <!-- entity-create:project --> marker. v1.7.2 PATCH (v0.47.0): no on-disk manifest changes; PATCH bump captures the fact that the installer's resolveEntityCreateEntry now auto-prepends {{templates_path}}/ on bare body_template basenames, changing this blueprint's registry output. Fixes BUG-3/4 from headspace Phase 3 (project atlas + Map + Board bodies were empty because the runtime _readBody resolved bare basenames against vault root). v1.8.0 MINOR (v0.48.0): NEW ProjectTaskCreateListener customjs class subscribes once at vault load (via NEW Templater startup template Project Task Create Listener.md) to vault.create for files matching ^spice/projects/<slug>/tasks/<file>.md$ and invokes Templater's replace-in-file-templater command on them. Fixes BUG-5 (kanban "+ Add a card" doesn't run Templater post-paste). NEW manifest field templater_startup_templates[]. Template, Kanban Card.md enhanced with "+ Create new workstream" sentinel + empty-workstreams Notice. v1.9.0 MINOR (v0.49.0 S1): NEW ProjectTaskCreateListenerInit customjs class registered in customjs plugin's startupScriptNames[] via NEW manifest field customjs_startup_scripts[]. Replaces v0.48.0's Templater startup_template registration mechanism (which failed silently at consumer vaults). v0.48.0's Templater wiring stays as belt-and-suspenders backstop (idempotent init via _initialized flag). v1.9.1 PATCH (v0.49.1): Template, Kanban Card.md source-board detection + auto-promote fix. Previously detectPath = targetPath || activePath produced vault-root path when kanban-plugin invokes Templater's create-new-note-from-template (Templater controls folder placement, defaulting to vault root). The new logic prefers tp.config.active_file (the source board the user clicked + Add a card on), so the workstream picker and auto-promote tp.file.move both fire correctly regardless of where Templater initially placed the file. Surfaced 2026-05-16: user reported new card files landing at vault root with no workstream prompt; root cause was that the kanban-plugin's per-board new-note-folder setting is ignored when new-note-template is set (kanban delegates folder placement to Templater). v1.10.4 PATCH (v0.50.5): ProjectNavButtons.render() main button row wraps to multiple flex rows when buttons don't fit (flex-wrap: wrap + flex: 0 1 auto + label white-space: nowrap). Fixes mobile clutter on long project/task names without removing buttons or labels. v1.11.0 MINOR (v0.51.0): NEW ProjectStatusWidget customjs class — colored status chip on the project hub with click-to-change picker (7-option overlay). Writes status + status_changed_at via app.fileManager.processFrontMatter. Sibling to ProjectWorkstreamManager. Adds new ## Status H2 section to Template, Project.md between the nav-buttons row and the existing ## Workstreams section. v1.11.1 PATCH (v0.51.1): Kanban Card template's _findSourceKanbanBoard now tries app.metadataCache.getBacklinksForFile(newFile) first (identity-based indexed lookup, no IO when cache is warm) before falling back to v0.49.2's vault-scan. Fallback preserved byte-for-byte for cold-cache safety. More robust on title collisions across the vault than substring-on-raw-bytes. v1.12.0 MINOR (v0.52.0): renamed the v0.50.0 "Wiki" surface to "Docs". ProjectWikiCards → ProjectDocsCards; templates Wiki Hub.md / Wiki Note.md → Docs Hub.md / Doc Note.md; subfolder convention spice/projects/<slug>/wiki/ → docs/; frontmatter types wiki-hub/wiki-note → docs-hub/doc-note; rules + tags ditto; entity-create entry id wiki-note → doc-note label "+ New Doc"; installer step applyWikiBackfill → applyDocsBackfill (folds FLN-1: now unconditional + repairs 0-byte Docs.md). NEW installer step applyWikiToDocsMigration runs per-project: backs up wiki/ to .sauce-backup/<slug>/wiki/<ts>/, renames wiki/ → docs/, renames Wiki.md → Docs.md, rewrites frontmatter (type + tags) + customJS.ProjectWikiCards → ProjectDocsCards refs inside each migrated .md. Idempotent (skips if docs/ already exists). Project-atlas "Wiki" button at project-nav-buttons.js:357 RENAMED to "Docs" (no new button surface). v1.12.1 PATCH (v0.52.1): _rmDirRecursive in applyWikiToDocsMigration falls back to Node fs.rmSync when adapter.rmdir is absent (CLI-mode adapter doesn't expose it). Without the fix, v0.52.0 install left empty wiki/ dirs alongside the new docs/ dirs at the first migration run. Fix adds WTD-MIG-4 test case exercising the fallback against a real tmpdir adapter. v1.13.4 PATCH (v0.59.8): retires v0.48.0's Templater startup_templates[] backstop. The Template, Project Task Create Listener.md template body calls customJS.ProjectTaskCreateListener.init() at Templater startup, but customJS hasn't finished loading its classes at that point — so customJS.ProjectTaskCreateListener is undefined and .init() throws "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'init')" in the console on every vault load. v0.49.0's customjs startupScriptNames[] path (ProjectTaskCreateListenerInit) is the working registration and remains. Edits: drop templater_startup_templates[] field + the Template, Project Task Create Listener.md files[] entry; delete the template source. NEW installer step pruneTemplaterStartupOrphans removes the orphan entry from each consumer's .obsidian/plugins/templater-obsidian/data.json startup_templates[] on next install (sunset after a couple releases). v1.13.6 PATCH (v0.59.11): Template, Kanban Card.md name-collision fix. (A) NEW Strategy 0 sibling-board detection runs FIRST in _findSourceKanbanBoard — if the new file's parent directory contains exactly one kanban-plugin board file, that board IS the source (path-based, bypasses title-substring pitfalls under collision). (B) Auto-promote `if (!existing)` skip replaced with suffix-disambiguation loop — when ${projectDir}/tasks/${fileName}/${fileName}.md exists, picks ${fileName}-2, ${fileName}-3, ... until a free slot is found (bounded ≤999); surfaces the rename via Notice. Fixes the bug where same-name tasks across projects (or sibling sub-tasks within same project) caused the new file to orphan at vault root or land in the wrong project. v1.14.0 MINOR (v0.61.0 FA-8): depends_on backlink-panel >=0.1.0; Template, Project.md grows ## Mentions H2 above the existing 'Project Notes & Referenced By' callout block — universal cross-blueprint backlink panel via canonical projects: cross-ref reverse query, grouped by note type (groupBy: 'type'). Additive to the existing ProjectReferencedByCards outlinks-based panel. v1.16.0 MINOR (v0.102.0 S3): NEW sections[] field on project frontmatter (declares per-project Docs Hub buckets — defaults to [Knowledge, Notes] when absent/empty). doc-note entity-create button extended with section + section_slug prompts (section prompts the user with default 'Knowledge'; section_slug derives via slugify(prompts.section)) AND destination.folder_prefix gains the {{prompts.section_slug}} subfolder AND frontmatter_template gains section: '{{prompts.section}}'. NEW ProjectDocsSections customjs class replaces ProjectDocsCards on Template, Docs Hub.md (Confluence-style per-section buckets with + New <Section> buttons via EntityCreate presetPrompts). NEW ProjectMeetingsPanel customjs class renders a ## Meetings H2 panel on Template, Project.md between ## Workstreams and ## Mentions (5 most-recent meetings + expand toggle + + New meeting button via EntityCreate presetPrompts.project). doc-note rule_fragment path_glob extended from spice/projects/*/docs/*.md → spice/projects/*/docs/**/*.md to cover docs nested in section subfolders. Strategy A migration is delivered in a follow-up Task 6 (within v0.102.0 cycle) as applyProjectSectionsMigration — hardcoded dispatch in install.js following the applyDocsHubButtonRepair pattern. v1.17.0 MINOR (v0.103.0 S3): hierarchical section-hub navigation tree replaces v0.102.0's Confluence-style single-page Docs Hub. NEW section-hub frontmatter schema (type, project, project_slug, section, section_slug, parent_section, depth: 1|2) + NEW doc-note sub_section field for depth-2 nesting. THREE new CustomJS helpers consumed: Breadcrumb (clickable trail rendered on every node), ProjectDocsIndex (replaces ProjectDocsSections on Docs.md — section cards + dashboard chips + + New Section / + New Doc shortcuts), SectionHub (depth-aware section + sub-section + doc rendering with + New Doc / + New Sub-Section buttons). TWO new entity-create entries (section-hub + sub-section-hub) plus doc-note button extended with optional sub_section + sub_section_slug prompts (destination.folder_prefix appends {{prompts.sub_section_slug}}, frontmatter_template gains sub_section: '{{prompts.sub_section}}'). Docs Hub template REWRITTEN to invoke Breadcrumb + ProjectDocsIndex. NEW Section Hub template (canonical for both depth 1 + depth 2 section-hubs). Doc Note template extended with a <!-- breadcrumb-v1.17.0 --> marker + Breadcrumb dataviewjs block at the top (above prior content). Project entity-create entry's extra_files[] gains Knowledge.md + Notes.md depth-1 section-hub materializations (out-of-box default sections for new projects). NEW rule_fragment target section-hub. Migration step applyProjectSectionsHubMigration is delivered in a follow-up Task 6 (within v0.103.0 cycle): heals existing Docs.md bodies (ProjectDocsCards / ProjectDocsSections → ProjectDocsIndex), materializes missing Section Hub notes per existing docs/<slug>/ subfolder, migrates doc-note section: 'Knowledge' frontmatter to wikilink form, injects the breadcrumb marker + block. v1.18.0 MINOR (v0.104.0 S3): registers DocSearch CustomJS helper consumed by ProjectDocsIndex + SectionHub. Adds an in-page filter UI (text input + dynamic tag chips + scoped-Obsidian-search button) on Docs.md and every Section Hub. Pure additive — no schema or template changes; existing v0.103.x vaults pick up the filter UI on next install via the materialized doc-search.js. v1.19.0 MINOR (v0.105.0 S3): docs-system-fixes brief — 10 issues across entity-create, templates, and helpers. (1) Doc Note template no longer ships the <!-- breadcrumb-v1.17.0 --> marker line — new docs come without it (the v0.103 install-time migration still injects the marker on EXISTING pre-v0.103 docs for idempotency, so the marker logic in _migrateDocNote stays intact). (2) Section Hub template no longer ships its own leading frontmatter block — entity-create's frontmatter_template provides the full block, so duplicating the body's frontmatter produced two stacked --- blocks with unresolved {{prompts.X}} markers. Template now starts with the first dataviewjs block. (3) doc-note section + sub_section prompts switch from free-text string to type: select with options_source: current_project_sections (section) and options_source: current_section_sub_sections (sub_section). Required entity-create@0.6.0. Empty options_source on an optional prompt is skipped silently (sub_section auto-defaults to "" when the section has no sub-sections). (4) section-hub.js drops the dv.header(3, "Docs") line — the # H1 file-name already labels the section, and the strip-of-docs cards is contextually clear. (5) section-hub.js + project-docs-index.js + doc-search.js polish: DocSearch refactor splits the input strip from the results container (input survives keystrokes — Issue 6 P0); inline SVG search icon replaces 🔎 emoji (Issue 9); EntityCreate render() calls wrapped in flex containers with flex: 1 styling so buttons span full width (Issue 8); docs queries sort by file.mtime desc for newest-first ordering (Issue 10). v1.20.0 MINOR (v0.106.0 S2-S3): DocSearch filter state persists to localStorage keyed by scopePath (independent state for Docs.md cross-section + each Section Hub within-section) — saved text + selected tags survive reload; restoration runs AFTER listeners are wired so chip-styling restore + initial filter render flow through the same code paths user interactions do. Input listener wrapped in a 150ms debounce — coalesces rapid keystrokes so the filter recomputes once after typing stops (tag-chip clicks remain synchronous). ProjectDocsIndex dashboard chip strip extended with three new chips beside the existing docs/meetings/status row: (a) task-note count under spice/projects/<slug>/tasks/ — chip omitted silently when zero; (b) recent activity — count of filtered docs whose file.mtime is within the last 7 days, omitted when zero; (c) top-3 tag chips via NEW _topTags helper that mirrors DocSearch._countTags semantics (doc-note universal tag excluded). All new chips share the existing chipStyle; flex-wrap handles overflow on narrow viewports. v1.21.0 MINOR (v0.109.0 — projects visual overhaul, MAJOR project-blueprint UX cycle covering Sections A–F of the post-v0.106.0.1 handoff): (A) DocSearch generalized in-place with entityType + placeholder + tagExclude opts; ProjectsHubCards adopts DocSearch (entityType: project) so Projects.md grows a text + tag-chip filter strip above the status/team/product chips. (B) Template, Project.md rewritten: drops the ## Status / ## Workstreams / ## Meetings / ## Mentions H2s + the BacklinkPanel block + the Project Notes & Referenced By callout entirely; new section order is Status → Meetings → Workstreams (Workstreams moved lower per user request); Breadcrumb is the first block of the template. ProjectMeetingsPanel rewritten as a SpaceDailyDashboard-style 3-card panel (no expand toggle, no empty-state callout) with attendees subtitle + Notes / open-task badges; ports _enrichMeeting from the daily-dashboard helper. (C) ProjectDocsIndex section cards on Docs.md gain last-updated meta + most-recent-doc subtitle + maxMtime DESC ordering. (D) NEW SectionLabel customjs primitive (small uppercase muted label + hairline divider) replaces every dv.header(3, ...) call across ProjectMeetingsPanel, ProjectWorkstreamManager, ProjectDocsIndex, SectionHub. (E) Breadcrumb extended with map / kanban / task-note type branches + path-based projectSlug fallback; Breadcrumb block added to Project Map / Project Board / Task Note templates. NEW installer step applyDocNoteBreadcrumbMarkerCleanup walks every project's docs/ tree recursively and strips legacy v0.103.0 <!-- breadcrumb-v1.17.0 --> markers (block preserved); _migrateDocNote's idempotency guard rewritten to check the class invocation substring instead of the visible marker comment. (F) NEW Docs/agent-guides/project-blueprint-ui.md locks the shared rendering primitives + section-ordering + spacing conventions. BacklinkPanel + ProjectNotesCards + ProjectReferencedByCards helper files stay shipped (cowork consumes BacklinkPanel; the other two are earmarked for cross-blueprint audit + sunset in a later cycle). Mechanism count UNCHANGED at 17. v1.26.0 MINOR (v0.127.0 task-interactions wave): Projects.md hub UX defaults updated per real-user pitch. (E1) default _activeStatuses scope expanded from 4-state ('idea', 'planning', 'in-progress', 'blocked') to ALL 7 states including terminal (done, superseded, cancelled) — every project visible at first render regardless of completion. Status-chip UI still drives interactive toggling. (E2) Within-group sort primary key changed from status priority ASC + status_changed_at DESC to the project folder's deepest mtime DESC (this._lookup[path].latestMtime.ts already computed for the per-card meta; reused for ordering). Status priority + status_changed_at retained as tiebreakers. Result: actively-worked projects bubble to the top whether or not their frontmatter status reflects it.

post_install.message: Project blueprint v1.0.0 installed at spice/projects/. To create your first project: open spice/projects/Projects.md (Cmd+O → search 'Projects') and click the 'New Project' action button. Per-project Kanban cards auto-promote to folder-style (tasks/<X>/<X>.md and board/<Y>/<Y>.md) via Templater. Workstream tagging on cards via the Change/Assign widget rendered on each card. Cmd+R required after this install to load the 3 CustomJS classes.

bootstrap_contributions.prompt: Filter expression for this engagement's primary kanban (blank = no filter)
